name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Bar on the upper back, feet about shoulder width. Brace, sit down between the hips, drive up through mid-foot. Knees track over toes.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Bar over mid-foot. Hinge to the bar, flat back, take the slack out, then push the floor away. Lock out hips and knees together.

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Shoulder blades retracted, feet planted. Lower to the lower chest under control, press back to lockout over the shoulders.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Bar on the front delts, ribs down, glutes tight. Press overhead, moving the head back then through as the bar clears.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge to roughly 45 degrees, flat back. Row to the lower ribs, elbows past the torso, lower under control.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Dead hang, shoulders engaged. Pull the chest toward the bar leading with the elbows, lower to full extension.

name: Dumbbell Lunge
instructions: Step forward, both knees to roughly 90 degrees, torso upright. Drive through the front heel to return. Reps are per side.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Heavy weight in each hand, ribs down, shoulders back. Walk with short controlled steps without letting the torso sway.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms under shoulders, straight line from head to heels. Squeeze glutes, ribs down, breathe.

name: BJJ Sparring (Gi)
instructions: Live rounds in the gi. Log total rolling time, not the whole class — warm-up and instruction carry very different cost.

name: BJJ Drilling
instructions: Cooperative technical repetition. Log the working time; intensity is captured by the session RPE, not by the duration alone.

name: Run
instructions: Any continuous run. Distance and elapsed time together give pace, so pace is derived rather than entered.
